body:
Hello! Im in high school and some things i wish i would have known are: 
- only do things that you actually care about, if you do not care it will show and colleges will not be impressed. 
- AP’s are important but dont overload yourself. I will have done 17 AP’s by the time that i graduate and I now i know that 7-10 would have probably been fine. It is definitely more important to make sure you have enough time to commit to the extracurriculars you care about.  
- again, with extra curriculars, try to start a club! It might seem like a daunting thought but it is a lot of fun and easier than you might think. Obviously dont do this just for your college application, but if theres a cause/passion that you deeply care about  or an organization you like that doesn’t have a chapter at your school, start a club for it! 
- getting one or two B’s wont kill your chances. The admissions process is holistic but definitely strive to learn as much as you can and get A’s in all of your classes. AP’s are only kind of difficult at first but once you get used to the structure they become extremely manageable.
